# Frame

> A Vue and TypeScript application framework with a persistent workbench shell,
> reusable themed controls, and optional Core modules.

The documentation website and offline readers use the same Markdown sources.
API tables are generated from Vue/TypeScript declarations and source comments;
styling references come from CSS declarations and their comments. Live previews
and playgrounds are separate Vue implementations.

Read the guide for the area being changed and check installed declarations.
Use public imports from `@frame/core` or `@frame/core/modules/<module>`.
Create one stable Frame instance per shell and render it with FrameShell.
The host owns domain state, backends, credentials, and persistence.

The typed `.use(moduleDescriptor)` installer and editorModule are implemented.
Other module descriptors and `frame.views.primarySidebar` remain architectural
proposals. Imports and module installation must not start backend work.

## Start here

- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): reading order and topic map.
- [Overview](docs/guides/overview.md): shell and reusable-control responsibilities.
- [Getting started](docs/guides/getting-started.md): installation and first shell.
- [How Frame works](docs/guides/how-it-works.md): state, lifecycle and modules.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration/frame-options.md): creation options.
- [Host integration](docs/guides/hosts.md): browser, Tauri and Electron.
- [Existing applications](docs/guides/existing-app.md): routers, stores and hosts.

## Reference

- [Components and modules](docs/components/README.md): canonical Markdown articles.
- [Layouts](docs/layouts/README.md): initial setup and shell APIs.
- [Public API types](docs/reference/api.md): generated declarations and member tables.
- [Shell contributions](docs/shell/README.md): views, menus, workspace and services.
- [Package boundaries](docs/reference/packages.md): ownership and public imports.
- [Core modules](packages/core/src/modules/README.md): optional capabilities.
- [Theme tokens](docs/styling/theme-variables.md): scopes, precedence and variables.
- [Theme files](docs/styling/theme-files.md): formats and dotted token paths.
- [Tailwind](packages/tailwind/README.md): optional build tooling.
- [Third-party notices](docs/licenses/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): dependency licenses.

Website deployments also provide complete individual `.md` files under
`markdown/docs/` and a generated `llms.txt` reading index. Registration, opening,
hiding and disposal are distinct operations; ordinary controls need no Frame
instance. Missing descriptions are explicitly identified in generated references
rather than inferred from property names.
